title: Ganga descends
introduction: Ganga descends to earth by the extraordinary effort of Bhageeratha. Shiva agrees to the alighting of Ganga on His head and from where she is released into a lake called Bindu sarovar, and from there she flows in seven courses. On land Bhageeratha ushers her up to netherworld dug by his ancestors where heaps of ashes of his grandparents are there, and she enters accordingly to inundate those mounds of ashes according salvation to the souls.
closing: इति वाल्मीकिरामायणे आदिकाव्ये बालकाण्डे त्रिचत्वारिंशः सर्गः
Thus, this is the 43rd chapter in Bala Kanda of Valmiki Ramayana, the First Epic poem of India.

verses.devanagari:
देवदेवे गते तस्मिन् सोंऽगुष्ठाग्रनिपीडिताम् |
कृत्वा वसुमतीं राम वत्सरं समुपासत
verses.iast:
deva deve gate tasmin so aṅguṣṭha agra nipīḍitām |
kṛtvā vasumatīm rāma vatsaram samupāsata
verses.translation: "When the god of gods Brahma left from there Bhageeratha stood on the tip of his big-toe praying for the mercy of Lord Shiva for one year, while that tip of his big-toe pressurised the earth." Thus Vishvamitra continued his narration about Bhageeratha's effort to bring Ganga to earth.
notes: Bhageeratha stood on one big-toe with an unwavering intent and bodily movement, and with his hands upraised in prayer for a period of one year by day and night, sustaining himself on mere air, and thus his yogic concentration increased and that alone pressurised the earth.

glosses.meaning: that, god, of gods [Brahma,] on leaving
for one year, he prayed - practised ascesis.

verses.devanagari:
अथ संवत्सरे पूर्णे सर्वलोकनमस्कृतः |
उमापतिः पशुपती राजानमिदमब्रवीत्
verses.iast:
atha saṃvatsare pūrṇe sarva loka namaskṛtaḥ |
umāpatiḥ paśupatī rājānam idam abravīt
verses.translation: "On completion of one year, he who is venerated by all worlds, the consort of Uma and the god of animals from insects to humans, that god Shiva revealed himself and spoke this to the king.

glosses.meaning: Uma's, consort, animal's, god of, [god Shiva]

verses.devanagari:
प्रीतस्तेऽहं नरश्रेष्ठ करिष्यामि तव प्रियम् |
शिरसा धारयिष्यामि शैलराजसुतामहम्
verses.iast:
prītaḥ te aham naraśreṣṭha kariṣyāmi tava priyam |
śirasā dhārayiṣyāmi śailarāja sutām aham
verses.translation: "Oh, best one among humans, I am delighted with your unwavering effort, and I will fulfil your cherish. I will therefore sustain Ganga, the daughter of king of mountains by my head.

glosses.meaning: oh, among humans, the best one
I am, of your - ascesis, happy

verses.devanagari:
ततो हैमवती ज्येष्ठा सर्वलोकनमस्कृता |
तदा सातिमहद्रूपं कृत्वा वेगं च दुःसहम्
आकाशादपतद्राम शिवे शिवशिरस्युत |
verses.iast:
tato haimavatī jyeṣṭhā sarva loka namaskṛtā |
tadā sā ati mahat rūpam kṛtvā vegam ca duḥsaham
ākāśāt apatat rāma śive śiva śirasy uta |
verses.translation: "Afterwards, she who is reverenced by all the worlds and who is the elder daughter of Himavanta, that Ganga assuming an unendurable form and an insupportable rapidity, they say, then plunged from the sky onto the auspicious head of Shiva.

glosses.meaning: by all, worlds, who is reverenced - such a Ganga

verses.devanagari:
अचिन्तयच्च सा देवी गङ्गा परमदुर्धरा
विशाम्यहं हि पातालं स्त्रोतसा गृह्य शंकरम् |
verses.iast:
acintayaḥ ca sā devī gaṅga parama dur.hdharā
viśāmi aham hi pātālam strotasā gṛhya śaṅkaram |
verses.translation: "She who is an extremely unendurable river that goddess Ganga even speculated saying to herself, 'let me enter netherworld, indeed whisking Shiva with my streams.'

glosses.meaning: I will, by streams, Shankara, on taking - by whisking
into netherworld, I will enter, indeed.

verses.devanagari:
तस्या वलेपनं ज्ञात्वा क्रुद्धस्तु भगवान् हरः
तिरोभावयितुं बुद्धिं चक्रे त्रिनयनस्तदा |
verses.iast:
tasyāḥ valepanam jñatva kruddhaḥ tu bhagavan haraḥ
tirobhāvayitum buddhim cakre trinayanaḥ tadā |
verses.translation: "Discerning her egotism god Shiva is infuriated, and then on his part that Three-eyed god Shiva thought to pent her up in the tufts of his head-hair.

glosses.meaning: to restrain - to pent-up, thinking, made - thought of.

verses.devanagari:
सा तस्मिन् पतिता पुण्या पुण्ये रुद्रस्य मूर्धनि
हिमवत्प्रतिमे राम जटामण्डलगह्वरे |
verses.iast:
sā tasmin patitā puṇyā puṇye rudrasya mūr.hdhani
himavat pratime rāma jaṭā maṇḍala gahvare |
verses.translation: "And oh, Rama, she that holy River Ganga swooped down into the cavernous curls of matted hair-tufts on the holy head of God Shiva, and she became a detainee in them.

glosses.meaning: in matted hair-tufts, curls of, [similar to] mountain caves - cavernous curls
on that, of Rudra's, holy, on head
she has fallen - swooped on - and became a detainee in those curls.

verses.devanagari:
सा कथञ्चिन्महीं गन्तुं नाशक्नोद्यत्नमास्थिता
नैव सा निर्गमं लेभे जटामण्डलमन्ततः |
verses.iast:
sā kathañcit mahīm gantum na aśak.hnot yatnam āsthitā
na eva sā nirgamam lebhe jaṭā maṇḍala antataḥ |
verses.translation: "Though she strove hard in one way or another to reach the earth that Ganga is rendered incapable, as she could not gain access for an outlet from any edge of the coils of matted hair-tufts of Shiva, hence she is held there in durance vile.

glosses.meaning: strive, though sit on - though she strived hard
she, not, thus, got - gained no access - hence held there in durance vile.

verses.devanagari:
तत्रैवाबंभ्रमद्देवी संवत्सरगणान्बहून्
तामपश्यन् पुनस्तत्र तपः परममास्थितः |
verses.iast:
tatra eva ābambhramat devī saṃvatsara gaṇān bahūn
tām apaśyan punaḥ tatra tapaḥ paramam āsthitaḥ |
verses.translation: "Goddess Ganga whirled round and round in the coils of tufts alone for many number of years, and when Ganga's emanation from those coils is intangible Bhageeratha again firmed up in a marvellous penance in the matter of her descent to earth.

glosses.meaning: again, in that matter - of her descent

verses.devanagari:
स तेन तोषितश्चासीदत्यन्तं रघुनंदन
विससर्ज ततो गङ्गां हरो बिन्दुसरः प्रति |
verses.iast:
sa tena toṣitaḥ ca asīt atyantam raghunandana
visasarja tato gaṅgām haro bindu saraḥ prati |
verses.translation: "Oh, Rama, the legatee of Raghu, with that ascesis of Bhageeratha god Shiva is very much delighted, and thereupon he has also released Ganga aiming at Bindu Lake in Himalayas.

glosses.meaning: Shiva, very much, delighted, he became

verses.devanagari:
तस्यां विसृज्यमानायां सप्त स्रोतंसि जज्ञिरे
ह्लादिनी पावनी चैव नलिनी च तथैव च |
तिस्रः प्राचीं दिशं जग्मुर्गंगाः शिवजलाः शुभाः
verses.iast:
tasyam visṛujyamānāyām sapta srotaṃsi jajñire
hlādinī pāvanī caiva nalinī ca tathā eva ca |
tisraḥ prācīm diśam jagmuḥ gaṅgāḥ śiva jalāḥ śubhāḥ
verses.translation: "While god Shiva released Ganga into Bindu Lake seven streams have emerged out of it, and thus three auspicious Ganga-s with holy waters have cruised eastward which are known as Hlaadini, Paavani, and Nalini.

verses.devanagari:
सुचक्षुश्चैव सीता च सिन्धुश्चैव महानदी |
तिस्रस्त्वेता दिशं जग्मुः प्रतीचीं तु शुभोदकाः
verses.iast:
sucakśuḥ ca eva sītā ca sindhuḥ ca eva mahānadī |
tisraḥ etā diśam jagmuḥ pratīcīm tu śubha udakāḥ
verses.translation: "Also thus Sucakshu, Seetha, and the excellent river Sindhu are the other three rivers which streamed to the westward direction with their holy waters.

glosses.meaning: westerly, to direction, have gone - flowed.

verses.devanagari:
सप्तमी चान्वगात्तासां भगीरथरथं तदा |
भगीरथोऽपि रजर्षिर्दिव्यं स्यंदनमास्थितः
प्रायादग्रे महातेजा गङ्गा तं चाप्यनुव्रजत् |
verses.iast:
saptamī ca anvagāt tāsam bhagīratha ratham tadā |
bhagīratho api rajar.hṣi divyam syandanam āsthitaḥ
prāyāt agre mahātejā gaṅga tam ca api anuvrajat |
verses.translation: "Of them the seventh Ganga flowed towards the path of Bhageeratha' chariot, and that great-resplendent and kingly sage Bhageeratha sitting in a divine chariot moved ahead and even Ganga followed him.

glosses.meaning: great resplendent, sagely king, Bhageeratha, even

verses.devanagari:
गगनाच्छङ्करशिरस्ततो धरणिमागता
व्यसर्पत जलं तत्र तीव्रशब्दपुरस्कृतम् |
verses.iast:
gaganāt śaṅkara śiraḥ tato dharaṇim āgatā
asarpata jalam tatra tīvra śabda puraskṛtam |
verses.translation: "Thus Ganga came from heavens onto Shankara's head and from there onto the earth, and there on earth her waters advanced with a tumultuous sound advancing them.
notes: The River Ganga is also called as tri patha gā 'she courses in three ways...' of which one kind of thinking is that she flowed from Himalayas to heaven, from heaven to Shiva's head and from there to earth. In the above context also, she is said to have the three-way-flow, i.e., one is eastward flow, second westward flow and the third is southward flow as led by Bhageeratha. The westward river Sindhu is the Indus and the eastward Nalini, which is now called as river Brahmaputra, while Ganga proper courses a little to south to move towards the ocean.

glosses.meaning: from there, onto earth, she came

verses.devanagari:
मत्स्यकच्छपसंघैश्च शिंशुमारगणैस्तथा
पतद्भिः पतितैश्चैव व्यरोचत वसुंधरा |
verses.iast:
matsya kacchapa saṅghaiḥ ca śiśumāra gaṇaiḥ tathā
patadbhiḥ patitaiḥ ca eva vyarocata vasundharā |
verses.translation: "The earth then verily shone forth with the shoals of fish, schools of tortoises, and scores of porpoises and other aquatic beings that have already fallen and that are still falling in step with the spates of Ganga.

glosses.meaning: still falling, also, thus - with Ganga's spates
of fishes, tortoises, shoals of, also

verses.devanagari:
ततो देवर्षिगंधर्वा यक्षा सिद्धगणास्तथा
व्यलोकयन्त ते तत्र गगनाद्गां गतां तदा |
verses.iast:
tato deva ṛṣi gandharvā yakṣa siddha gaṇāḥ tathā
vyalokayanta te tatra gaganāt gām gatām tadā |
verses.translation: "Later, they the gods, sages, gandharva-s, yaksha-s, and the assemblages of siddha-s have then seen there the swoop of Ganga in that way from heaven to earth, with curiosity.

glosses.meaning: from heaven, to earth, proceeded to - reached, swoop of

verses.devanagari:
विमानैर्नगराकारैर्हयैर्गजवरैस्तथा
पारिप्लवगताश्चापि देवतास्तत्र विष्ठिताः |
verses.iast:
vimānaiḥ nagara ākāraiḥ hayaiḥ gaja varaiḥ tathā
pāriplava gatāḥ ca api devatāḥ tatra viṣṭhitāḥ |
verses.translation: "Some of the gods with aircrafts that are like cities in their shape and size, and some with horses that are prancing, and some with best elephants that are staggering, at the very sight of plunging Ganga, have entered the firmament at that place.

glosses.meaning: city like, in shape and size, who are with aircrafts - some of them
in franticness, which have gone in - horses prancing, elephants staggering
with elephants, best ones - some of them
at that place, they entered - in firmament.

verses.devanagari:
तदद्भुततमं लोके गंगापतनमुत्तमम्
दिदृक्षवो देवगणाः समीयुरमितौजसः |
verses.iast:
tat adbhutatamam loke gaṅgā avataram uttamam
didṛkṣavo deva gaṇāḥ samīyuḥ amita ojasaḥ |
verses.translation: "The gods whose animation is unlimited, and who are anxious to see the plunge of Ganga, have come together in assemblages, which plunge is a highest marvel in the universe by a better degree of her illimitable animation than that of gods who came to see, and even benignant to the world in according water and salving souls, which those gods cannot do.

glosses.meaning: marvel, to a higher degree of comparison - highest
gods, assemblages, have come together. This verse implicitly compares her dynamism and the routine dynamism of gods in general.

verses.devanagari:
संपतद्भिः सुरगणैस्तेषां चाभरणौजसा
शतादित्यमिवाभाति गगनं गततोयदम् |
verses.iast:
sampatadbhiḥ sura gaṇaiḥ teṣām ca ābharaṇa ojasā
śata ādityam iva ābhāti gaganam gata toyadam |
verses.translation: "The glitter of the ornaments of hosts of gods who are in stampede, made the cloudless sky to shine as if it is with a hundred of suns.

glosses.meaning: gone, clouds, sky - sky clear of clouds
well, coming falling - falteringly coming - stampeding
with their, ornaments, with glitter of
a hundred, suns, as if - having

verses.devanagari:
शिंशुमारोरगगणैर्मीनैरपि च चंचलैः
विद्युद्भिरिव विक्षिप्तैराकाशमभवत्तदा |
verses.iast:
śiṃśumāra uraga gaṇaiḥ mīnaiḥ api ca cañcalaiḥ
vidyudbhiḥ iva vikṣiptaiḥ ākāśam abhavat tadā |
verses.translation: "At that time, with the falling and rising of scores of porpoises and reptiles, even with the wriggling fishes, the sky became flashy as if flashes of lightning are strewn over it.

glosses.meaning: with wriggling, fishes, even, also - that are falling and rising with streams
flashes of lightning, strewn, as if

verses.devanagari:
पाण्डुरैः सलिलोत्पीडैः कीर्यमाणैः सहस्रधा
शारदाभ्रैरिवाकीर्णं गगनं हंससंप्लवैः |
verses.iast:
pāṇḍuraiḥ salila utpīḍaiḥ kīryamāṇaiḥ sahasradhā
śārada abhraiḥ iva ākrīṇam gaganam haṃsa samplavaiḥ |
verses.translation: "Spattered innumerably with the whitish froth from the splashes of Ganga, and stippled with the flights of swans, the sky is as though overspread with silver-clouds of autumn.

glosses.meaning: in thousands of ways - innumerably, bespattered
water's upward, pressure - born out of = with froth
spread over, as if - the sky is.

verses.devanagari:
क्वचिद् द्रुततरं याति कुटिलं क्वचिदायतम्
विनतं क्वचिदुद्धूतं क्वचिद्याति शनैः शनैः |
verses.iast:
kvacit drutataram yāti kuṭilam kvacit āyatam
vinatam kvacit uddhūtam kvacit yāti śanaiḥ śanaiḥ |
verses.translation: "Somewhere Ganga is coursing precipitately, elsewhere sinuously, somewhere else staightly, elsewhere sloppily, somewhere gushingly, and somewhere else her cruise is leisurely and tardily.

glosses.meaning: slowly, slowly - leisurely and tardily, she cruises.

verses.devanagari:
सलिलेनैव सलिलं क्वचिदभ्याहतं पुनः
मुहुरूर्ध्वपथं गत्वा पपात वसुधां पुनः |
verses.iast:
salilena eva salilam kvacit abhyāhatam punaḥ
muhur ūrdhva patham gatvā papāta vasudhām punaḥ |
verses.translation: "Somewhere her water repeatedly knocking against her own water is recurrently billowing upwards only to make nosedive onto earth.

glosses.meaning: towards, knocking - colliding with, crashing into
upper, way on going - billowing upwards
on earth, again, has fallen - refluent tide making a nosedive.

verses.devanagari:
तच्छङ्करशिरोभ्रष्टं भ्रष्टं भूमितले पुनः
व्यरोचत तदा तोयं निर्मलं गतकल्मषम् |
verses.iast:
tat śaṅkara śiro bhraṣṭam bhraṣṭam bhūmi tale punaḥ
vyarocata tadā toyam nirmalam gata kalmaṣam |
verses.translation: "That impeccable and immaculate water of Ganga then became outstanding as it has flounced down from heaven primarily onto the head of Shankara, and therefrom it has coasted down onto the earth.

glosses.meaning: on Sankara's, on head, that which slipped - flounced down
on earth's, surface, slipped - coasted down
then, shone forth - became outstanding river.

verses.devanagari:
तत्रर्षिगणगन्धर्वा वसुधातलवासिनः
भवाङ्गपतितं तोयं पवित्रमिति पस्पृशुः |
verses.iast:
tatra ṛṣi gaṇa gandharvā vasudhā tala vāsinaḥ
bhava aṅga patitam toyam pavitram iti paspṛśuḥ |
verses.translation: "And asserting that the water as holy, because it descended touching the body of Shiva, viz., the head of Shiva, the assemblages of sages, gandharva-s, and those that are residents on the plane of earth have sipped that water at that place.

glosses.meaning: from Bhava's - Shiva's, body - head, fell from - descended, water

verses.devanagari:
शापात् प्रपतिता ये च गगनाद्वसुधातलम्
कृत्वा तत्राभिषेकं ते बभूवुर्गतकल्मषाः |
verses.iast:
śāpāt prapatitā ye ca gaganāt vasudhā talam
kṛtvā tatra abhiṣekam te babhūvuḥ gata kalmaṣāḥ |
verses.translation: "Also those that have fallen from heaven onto the surface of earth by some curse or the other, they too became blemishless on taking head-bath in the water of Ganga.

glosses.meaning: in that - in water of Ganga
gone, blemishes - free from blemishes, they became.

verses.devanagari:
धूतपापाः पुनस्तेन तोयेनाथ शुभान्विता
पुनराकाशमाविश्य स्वान् लोकान् प्रतिपेदिरे |
verses.iast:
dhūta pāpāḥ punaḥ tena toyena atha śubha anvitā
punaḥ ākāśam āviśya svān lokān pratipedire |
verses.translation: "When sins are washed away with the hallowing water of Ganga, they again transited skyward and then obtained their own empyrean worlds once again.

glosses.meaning: again, to sky, on entering - transiting skyward
again, their own, empyrean-worlds, they obtained,.

verses.devanagari:
मुमुदे मुदितो लोकस्तेन तोयेन भास्वता
कृताभिषेको गंगायां बभूव विगतक्लमः |
verses.iast:
mumude mudito lokaḥ tena toyena bhāsvatā
kṛta abhiṣeko gaṅgāyām babhūva gata kalmaṣaḥ |
verses.translation: "With her splendorous water people are blissful, and on taking dip-baths in Ganga they are totally removed of the strains of their sins, and they lived blissfully ever after.

glosses.meaning: totally, removed, strain - strain of sins

verses.devanagari:
भगीरथोऽपि राजर्षिर्दिव्यं स्यंदनमास्थितः
प्रायादग्रे महातेजास्तं गंगा पृष्ठतोऽन्वगात् |
verses.iast:
bhagīratho rājarṣiḥ divyam syandanam āsthitaḥ
prāyāt agre mahārājāḥ tam gaṅgā pṛṣṭhato anvagāt |
verses.translation: "In this way, the great-resplendent and kingly sage Bhageeratha sitting in a divine chariot continuously moved ahead and Ganga continually followed him at his behind.
notes: This verse is almost similar to the verse No. 14 above. But here, the continuous actions of both the leader and the led are implied with ellipses - 'in this way', and 'continuously.'

glosses.meaning: very well - continuously] anvagaat = Ganga, at his behind, followed - this is continued action.

verses.devanagari:
देवाः सर्षिगणाः सर्वे दैत्यदानवराक्षसाः
गन्धर्वयक्षप्रवराः सकिंनरमहोरगाः |
सर्पाश्चाप्सरसो राम भगीरथरथानुगाः
गंगामन्वगमन् प्रीताः सर्वे जलचराश्च ये |
verses.iast:
devāḥ sa ṛṣi gaṇāḥ sarve daitya dānava rākṣasāḥ
gandharva yakṣa pravarāḥ sa kiṃnara mahoragāḥ |
sarpāḥ ca apsaraso rāma bhagīratha ratha anugāḥ
gaṅgām anvagaman prītāḥ sarve jala carāḥ ca ye |
verses.translation: "Oh, Rama, all of the gods along with the assemblages of sages, ogres, monsters, demons, and even great reptiles with kinnara-s, and gandharva-s with best yaksha-s, and even serpents and apsara-s, have delightfully moved after Ganga who is following the chariot of Bhageeratha, and why they, in fact, all of the aquatic beings have followed Ganga. [31b, 32, 33a]

glosses.meaning: Bhageeratha's, chariot, one who is following

verses.devanagari:
यतो भगीरथो राजा ततो गंगा यशस्विनी
जगाम सरितां श्रेष्ठा सर्वपापप्रणाशिनी |
verses.iast:
yato bhagīratho rājā tato gaṅgā yaśasvinī
jagāma saritām śreṣṭhā sarva pāpa praṇāśinī |
verses.translation: "In whichever direction king Bhageeratha has advanced, that glorious River Ganga, who is the prominent river among all the rivers and the complete obliterator of sins, has also moved at his behind in that direction.

verses.devanagari:
ततो हि यजमानस्य जह्नोरद्भुतकर्मणः
गङ्गा संप्लावयामास यज्ञवाटं महत्मनः |
verses.iast:
tato hi yajamānasya jahnoḥ adbhuta karmaṇaḥ
gaṅga samplāvayāmāsa yajña vāṭam mahatmanaḥ |
verses.translation: "While in flow she started to completely inundate the field of Vedic-ritual belonging to the great-souled sage Jahnu, who is of marvellous deeds and who is presently an officiator of an ongoing Vedic-ritual.

glosses.meaning: who is an officiator of a Vedic-ritual

verses.devanagari:
तस्यावलेपनं ज्ञात्वा क्रुद्धो जह्नुश्च राघव
अपिबत्तु जलं सर्वं गङ्गायाः परमाद्भुतम् |
verses.iast:
tasayā valepanam jñatva kṛddho jahnuḥ ca rāghava
apibat tu jalam sarvam gaṅgayāḥ parama adbhutam |
verses.translation: "But on knowing her hubris, oh, Raghava, that sage Jahnu has become irritated and causing an extreme marvel he drank off all the water of Ganga.

verses.devanagari:
ततो देवाः सगन्धर्वा ऋषयश्च सुविस्मिताः
पूजयन्ति महात्मानं जह्नुं पुरुषसत्तमम् |
गङ्गां चापि नयन्ति स्म दुहितृत्वे महात्मनः
verses.iast:
tato devāḥ sa gaṅgharva ṛṣayaḥ ca su vismitāḥ
pūjayanti mahatmanam jahnum puruṣa sattamam |
gaṅgam ca api nayanti sma duhitṛtve mahātmanaḥ
verses.translation: "Thereupon, the gods along with gandharva-s and sages at that extremely marvellous feat of Sage Jahnu are highly astounded, and they then started to worship that ablest human and great-souled sage Jahnu, and even deigned for the daughterhood of Ganga to that high-souled sage Jahnu.

glosses.meaning: at sage Jahnu, they started to worship
even, taken as - to ascribe, deigned to, they are.

verses.devanagari:
ततस्तुष्टो महातेजाः श्रोत्राभ्यामसृजत् प्रभुः |
तस्माज्जह्नुसुता गङ्गा प्रोच्यते जाह्नवीति च
verses.iast:
tataḥ tuṣṭaḥ mahātejāḥ śrotrābhyām asṛujat prabhuḥ |
tasmāt jahnu sutā gaṅga procyate jāhnavī iti ca
verses.translation: "That greatly radiant and godly sage Jahnu is then delighted and released Ganga from both of his ears. Therefore Ganga became the daughter of sage Jahnu, and she is also renowned as Jahnavi, after the name of that sage.

glosses.meaning: from two ears, created - released Ganga
Ganga, sage Jahnu's, daughter, - she became

verses.devanagari:
जगाम च पुनर्गङ्गा भगीरथरथानुगा |
सागरं चापि संप्राप्ता सा सरित्प्रवरा तदा
रसातलमुपागच्छत् सिद्ध्यर्थं तस्य कर्मणः |
verses.iast:
jagāma ca punaḥ gaṅga bhagīratha ratha anugā |
sāgaram ca api sampraptā sā sarit pravarā tadā
rasātalam upāgacchat siddhyartham tasya karmaṇaḥ |
verses.translation: "Even though Ganga again proceeded moving behind the chariot of Bhageeratha and reached the ocean, therefrom she had to wend her way to netherworld, once dug by the sons of Sagara, only to accomplish the mission of Bhageeratha, namely drenching the ashes of Sagara's sons.
notes: Some take the word sāgaram as the netherworld dug by the sons of Sagara and omit the mention of her ocean-bound travel.

glosses.meaning: Bhageeratha's, chariot, behind, while moving - following
near, coming, gone - arrived, had to wend her way.

verses.devanagari:
भगीरथोऽपि रजार्षिर्गङ्गामादाय यत्नतः
पितामहान् भस्मकृतानपश्यद्गतचेतनः |
verses.iast:
bhagīratho api rajārṣi gaṅgam ādāya yatnataḥ
pitamahān bhasma krutam apaśyat gata cetanaḥ |
verses.translation: "Even kingly-sage Bhageeratha making every effort ushered Ganga to netherworld, but on seeing his grandparents rendered to ashes he has became doleful.

glosses.meaning: diina cetanaH = with a pitiable, heart - became doleful

verses.devanagari:
अथ तद्भस्मनां राशिं गङ्गासलिलमुत्तमम् |
प्लावयत् पूतपाप्मानः स्वर्गं प्रप्ता रघूत्तम
verses.iast:
atha tat bhasmanām rāśim gaṅga salilam uttamam |
plāvayat pūta pāpmānaḥ svargam praptā raghu uttama
verses.translation: "Oh, Rama, the best of Raghu's dynasty, then Ganga inundated that mound of ashes of Sagara's six-thousand sons, by which those souls obtained heaven, while the sins of souls are cleansed with the water of Ganga." Thus Vishvamitra continued his narration. [1-43-41b, c]

glosses.meaning: cleansing, sins - of souls of Sagara's sons
